feature: Login flow - ed-tech application (mobile number + OTP)

requirementSource.description: Need to automate the login flow of ed-tech https://stg.zoworld.app/ed-tech/ . Give me test cases

testCases.title: Login page loads with correct initial state
testCases.expectedResult: Page loads with: empty 'Mobile number' field, fixed '+91' country code prefix, unchecked 'I agree to the Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy' checkbox, and a disabled 'Send OTP' button.

testCases.title: Mobile number field accepts only numeric input
steps: Enter 'abcde12345' into the Mobile number field
testCases.expectedResult: Non-numeric characters are stripped; field value is '12345'.

testCases.title: Mobile number field is capped at 10 digits
steps: Enter '123456789012345' (15 digits) into the Mobile number field
testCases.expectedResult: Field value is truncated to the first 10 digits: '1234567890'.

testCases.title: Send OTP remains disabled when Terms & Conditions checkbox is not checked
steps: Do not select the Terms & Conditions checkbox

testCases.title: Send OTP becomes enabled when mobile number is entered and checkbox is checked
Send OTP becomes disabled again when checkbox is unchecked
preconditions: Mobile number entered and checkbox previously checked
steps: Select the Terms & Conditions checkbox (button becomes enabled)
testCases.expectedResult: Send OTP button becomes disabled again.

testCases.title: Send OTP is enabled even when mobile number has fewer than 10 digits (checkbox checked)
steps: Enter a partial mobile number '98765' (5 digits)
testCases.expectedResult: Observed: Send OTP button is enabled (no client-side minimum-length validation gates the button). Whether this is intended product behavior is UNKNOWN - see unknownBehavior.

testCases.title: Send OTP is enabled even when mobile number field is empty (checkbox checked)
steps: Leave the Mobile number field empty
testCases.expectedResult: Observed: Send OTP button is enabled (no client-side required-field validation gates the button beyond the checkbox). Whether this is intended product behavior is UNKNOWN - see unknownBehavior.

testCases.title: Terms & Conditions link points to the expected URL
steps: Verify its href attribute without navigating away

testCases.title: Privacy Policy link points to the expected URL
steps: Verify its href attribute without navigating away

testCases.title: Language toggle control is displayed on the login page
steps: Verify the 'English' button is visible near the top of the page
testCases.expectedResult: The 'English' language toggle button is displayed. Its underlying behavior (e.g. what languages it switches to) was not inspected and is UNKNOWN.

testCases.title: Send OTP triggers OTP delivery and navigates to OTP entry screen

testData.mobileNumber: UNKNOWN - requires a real/QA-approved test number

testCases.expectedResult: UNKNOWN - not observed. Expected to trigger OTP delivery and display an OTP entry screen, but this was not verified to avoid triggering a real OTP.
testCases.blockedReason: No QA OTP mechanism available; executing this step would trigger a real OTP send.

testCases.title: Login succeeds with a valid OTP
preconditions: OTP has been sent to a valid mobile number
testCases.expectedResult: UNKNOWN - post-verification success behavior (redirect target, session state) has not been observed or documented.
testCases.blockedReason: No QA OTP mechanism available; requires a real OTP value that cannot be obtained or invented.

testCases.title: Login fails with an invalid/incorrect OTP
preconditions: OTP has been sent to a valid mobile number
testCases.expectedResult: UNKNOWN - error message/behavior for invalid OTP has not been observed or documented.
testCases.blockedReason: No QA OTP mechanism available; requires triggering a real OTP flow first.

testCases.title: Resend OTP functionality
preconditions: OTP has been sent to a valid mobile number
steps: Wait for/locate a 'Resend OTP' option, if present
testCases.expectedResult: UNKNOWN - existence, timer, and behavior of a resend mechanism have not been observed.
testCases.blockedReason: No QA OTP mechanism available; OTP screen has not been reached without triggering a real OTP.

testCases.title: Login attempt with an unregistered mobile number

testData.mobileNumber: UNKNOWN - requires a known-unregistered test number

testCases.expectedResult: UNKNOWN - whether unregistered numbers are auto-registered or rejected has not been documented or observed.
testCases.blockedReason: No QA OTP mechanism available; requires triggering a real OTP send and knowledge of registration status of a test number.

blockedScenarios: TC-012: Send OTP triggers OTP delivery and navigates to OTP entry screen
TC-013: Login succeeds with a valid OTP
TC-014: Login fails with an invalid/incorrect OTP
TC-016: Login attempt with an unregistered mobile number
unknownBehavior: Whether the missing client-side minimum-length validation on the mobile number field (observed in TC-007) is intended product behavior
Whether the missing client-side required-field validation on the mobile number field (observed in TC-008) is intended product behavior

OTP length, format, and expiry duration
OTP resend availability, cooldown/timer, and maximum resend attempts
Success behavior after valid OTP entry (redirect target, session/token issuance, welcome screen)
Failure behavior after invalid OTP entry (error message, remaining attempts, lockout policy)

Functionality of the 'English' language toggle control
